question: True or false: right after setCount(count + 1), the count variable in the same handler already holds the new value.
say: True or false: right after set count, count plus one, the count variable in the same handler already holds the new value.
explanation: False. Setting state requests a new render. The count variable in the current handler keeps the value from this render.
explainSay: False. Setting state asks for a new render. The variable in this handler keeps its old value.
